title: Akane's Modpack Base
description: A neoforge modpack base that adds support to connected textures, custom animations, distant horizons, and many other must have features on a modpack.
body:
This is a NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack base that adds many must have features every modpack should have even if you wont use some of the features due to hardware limitations(potato pc)

This base adds:
- zoom
- worldmap
- connected textures
- shaders
- compatibility with custom animation resourcepacks
- performance optimizations (server and clientside)
- saturation
- keybindpurger and keybind manager (controlling)
- jade
- inventory sorter
- mouse tweaks

You can use this base to make any modpack you like, making your life easier getting a pre made base that works on vanilla servers too.
